eventDetail.scope: DISHA 2026, themed “Generative Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Internet of Things,” envisions a future where intelligent systems seamlessly integrate learning, perception, generation, and real-time sensing to enable autonomous, scalable, and human-centric digital ecosystems. The conference serves as a global forum for advances in deep learning architectures, generative AI and large language models, computer vision, natural language processing, and edge intelligence. Emphasis is placed on AI–IoT convergence, smart sensing, embedded intelligence, and semantic communication systems for real-time, secure, and energy-efficient operation. Application domains include smart healthcare, autonomous and robotic systems, intelligent networking, and smart content creation. The scope further emphasizes ethical, explainable, and trustworthy AI to ensure responsible innovation aligned with societal needs and sustainable digital transformation.
